scope: Proposition 4.2 (Mixed-boundary extension) of the manuscript “Universal-cover splitting for compact Kähler manifolds” (preprints/Universal-cover-splitting-for-compact-Kahler-manifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 052 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 14d3e3f23539fd98), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B ⊂ C2 s,t be a convex open set, and let f : B → X be a holomorphic box. Suppose that p ∈ ∂B has a C2 defining function with nonzero differential. If the complex tangent line to ∂B at p is generated by a vector with both components nonzero, then f extends as a holomorphic box to a neighborhood of p, agreeing with f on its intersection with B.
